Normal volume at least prior 36-bar median; retest at least 1.25x. Single levels/clusters valid. Estimated target must clear twice 0.14% fee/slippage allowance. Indicator thresholds and exits identical/frozen between accounts.
fast_reaction_pair.risk_contract: Automatic 3x. Context bias -2/-1/0/+1/+2 selects long/short leverage block:5, 2:4, 3:3, 4:2, 5:block. Normal/reduced exposure factor 1/0.5. Normal/strong_only/paused entry permission. Up to 25% equity margin per position, 2% planned loss including cost allowance per position, 4% combined planned loss across all positions, max three positions. Actual gap/funding/fill losses can exceed planned loss. No adds or leverage changes to open trades.
fast_reaction_pair.exit_contract: Fill-frozen 1.5-entry-ATR price stop, 3-entry-ATR target, completed-candle loss of trigger level, one-hour stall or four-hour maximum hold. Stored protection remains active after modifier expiry. Emergency -20% leveraged position stop is a backstop, not intended routine loss.
fast_reaction_pair.publication_contract: Only main agent publishes sourced expiring controls through paper_fast_control and its one journal. swing_level_pair.purpose: Matched PAPER comparison of two less-twitchy swing-level entry mechanisms on the same six-pair universe, equal isolated virtual capital, risk envelope, and protective exits. Learning trial only; no profitability claim.
swing_level_pair.timeframe_contract: Use only pre-existing levels from completed H1, H4, and D1 candles; H1 is the decision/confirmation timeframe.
swing_level_pair.comparison: bounce enters on a completed-H1 bounce/rejection; break_hold requires the break and a second completed-H1 close holding beyond the level. Other risk and exit rules remain matched.
swing_level_pair.risk_contract: Each account starts with 10000 USDT virtual equity, isolated margin, 3x leverage, at most 3 positions, at most 25% equity margin per position, 2% planned equity loss per trade and 4% combined planned equity loss; 20% margin-loss emergency backstop. No exchange credentials or order API.
swing_level_pair.exit_contract: Structural stop 0.5 ATR beyond the level, with at least 1.5 ATR room; use a pre-existing level target only when cost-adjusted reward is at least 1.5R, otherwise a 2R volatility target. Invalidate after two completed H1 candles; maximum hold 48 hours.
swing_level_pair.initial_history: Both identities are newly registered but uninitialized: no DB, trades, orders, or prior balance at registration. The runtime helper records the initialization attempt and confirmed DB initialization during the one attended first launch.

vacuum.purpose: Does directional volume pressure carry a break or pullback through a thin profile region toward the next substantial volume or structure level?
vacuum.exit_contract: Freeze structural invalidation and ATR at entry; target the next useful profile or structure level, or a labelled volatility objective; tighten after meaningful cost-adjusted progress and allow strong continuation.
vacuum.entry_mode: automatic family-specific primary plus labelled exploratory long/short ranking

reclaim.purpose: Is a high/low sweep being rejected despite large activity, using pre-existing extremes, wick/reclaim geometry, limited follow-through and changing pressure/momentum?
reclaim.exit_contract: Stop beyond the swept extreme with volatility room; seek value/midpoint then a larger opposite reaction zone; leave on a failed reclaim rather than ordinary price wiggle.
reclaim.entry_mode: automatic family-specific primary plus labelled exploratory long/short ranking

auction.purpose: Can price rotate through a stable value/range auction when overlapping timeframe boundaries and changing pressure favour an edge-to-centre move?
auction.exit_contract: Freeze the stop outside the auction boundary; target a useful centre/opposite value region; detect a genuine range escape before repeated mean-reversion losses.
auction.entry_mode: automatic family-specific primary plus labelled exploratory long/short ranking

rotation.purpose: Which liquid alt is strengthening/weakening relative to its cohort and BTC/ETH background, and does local structure allow joining that move?
rotation.exit_contract: Use a local pullback/structure stop; follow continuing relative momentum; exit when the meaningful relative/pressure advantage or protected price boundary fails.
rotation.entry_mode: automatic family-specific primary plus labelled exploratory long/short ranking
